name: Meta Platforms

eyebrow.en: Meta Platforms, Inc. · Class A · Menlo Park, California
eyebrow.zh: Meta Platforms · A类股 · 加州门洛帕克

title.en: Ads are booming; the AI bill has arrived.
title.zh: 广告大卖，AI 账单也来了。

lede.en: Meta grew revenue 26% to $64.6B in Q3 and guided Q4 above consensus, but a $9.9B youth-safety settlement charge cut operating margin to 20%, and $34.9B of capex pushed free cash flow negative for the first time. No buybacks in Q3; Meta plans a new non-voting Class C share.
lede.zh: Meta 第三季营收增 26% 至 646 亿美元，第四季指引高于预期；但 99 亿美元青少年安全和解费用使营业利润率降至 20%，349 亿美元资本开支令自由现金流首次转负。第三季未回购，并计划发行无投票权的新 C 类股。

s.en: trailing GAAP EPS $29.33 · ~21× excluding the Q3 legal charge
s.zh: GAAP 历史每股 $29.33 · 剔除第三季法律费用约 21 倍
2026 第四季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock fell 8% after Q2 results, then re-rated on the Muse AI agent; it rose about 4% after hours on the Q3 beat and Q4 guide.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。第二季财报后股价下跌 8%，其后因 Muse AI 智能体重新估值；第三季业绩超预期、第四季指引强劲，盘后上涨约 4%。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. GAAP EPS of $1.05 in Q3 2025 reflects a one-time tax charge, and $3.83 in Q3 2026 a $9.89B legal charge ($7.40 excluding it). The last bar is the midpoint of Meta's Q4 2026 guidance of $73–76B.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。2025 第三季 GAAP 每股 $1.05 反映一次性税务费用，2026 第三季 $3.83 反映 98.9 亿美元法律费用（剔除后为 $7.40）。最后一根柱为 Meta 2026 第四季指引 730–760 亿美元的中值。

s.zh: 同比 +26% · 高于约 633 亿预期

s.en: 35.4% excl. legal charge · 40.1% a year ago
s.zh: 剔除法律费用 35.4% · 一年前 40.1%

s.en: incl. finance leases · 1.8× a year ago
s.zh: 含融资租赁 · 为一年前 1.8 倍
中值高于约 736 亿预期

p.en: Revenue grew 26% in Q3 as ad impressions rose 10% and price per ad 14%. The Q4 guide of $73–76B implies about 22–27% growth, and Meta expects strong growth through 2027.
p.zh: 第三季营收增 26%，广告展示量增 10%、单价增 14%。第四季 730–760 亿美元指引意味着增长约 22–27%，Meta 预计 2027 年全年保持强劲增长。

p.en: More than 10M people set up the Muse AI agent in about six weeks. Headcount is down 15% YoY to 66,775, and Reality Labs losses should narrow to about $15B in 2027.
p.zh: 约六周内逾 1000 万人开通 Muse AI 智能体。员工数同比减 15% 至 66,775 人，Reality Labs 亏损预计 2027 年收窄至约 150 亿美元。

p.en: 2026 capex is guided at $135–145B, implying about $49–59B in Q4. Free cash flow was −$2.1B in Q3 on Meta's measure, and buybacks have stopped.
p.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引 1350–1450 亿美元，意味着第四季约 490–590 亿。按 Meta 口径第三季自由现金流为 −21 亿美元，回购已暂停。

h.en: Borrowing and the Class C share

p.en: Long-term debt rose to $80.9B from $58.7B in December, about equal to cash and securities of $82.4B. A non-voting Class C share (one per existing share, due Jan 2027) can be used to raise capital or pay for deals.
p.zh: 长期债务从去年 12 月的 587 亿升至 809 亿美元，与 824 亿现金及证券相当。无投票权 C 类股（每股派一股，预计 2027 年 1 月）可用于融资或并购。

p.en: The attorneys-general deal provides up to about $18.6B in payments, and a New Mexico judge ordered $25B over Cambridge Analytica, which Meta will appeal. More youth-safety trials are scheduled.
p.zh: 与各州总检察长的和解最多需支付约 186 亿美元；新墨西哥州法官就剑桥分析案判罚 250 亿，Meta 将上诉。更多青少年安全审判仍在排期。

p.en: Lost $4.13B in Q3 and is guided to lose $18–19B in 2026, on revenue of under $0.5B a quarter.
p.zh: 第三季亏损 41.3 亿美元，2026 年指引亏损 180–190 亿，每季营收不足 5 亿。

h.zh: 第四季及 2026 全年业绩

p.en: Guide: revenue $73–76B. Expected to include 2027 capex and expense outlooks.
p.zh: 指引：营收 730–760 亿美元。预计将给出 2027 年资本开支与费用展望。

p.en: Intended effective date of the non-voting Class C stock; one share is paid per Class A or B share and the Class A price should adjust like a 2-for-1 split.
p.zh: 无投票权 C 类股拟生效日；每股 A 或 B 类股派发一股，A 类股价格将如 1 拆 2 般调整。

h.zh: 青少年安全审判与上诉

p.en: More US trials are scheduled, and Meta is appealing the $25B New Mexico ruling.
p.zh: 美国更多审判排期中，Meta 正就新墨西哥州 250 亿美元判决上诉。

sources: Price, market cap, beta, targets: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 22, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Meta Platforms, Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月22日（2026 第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Meta Platforms, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第四季至 2026 年第三季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Meta generated $5–16B of free cash flow almost every quarter for five years, enough to fund large buybacks. In Q3 2026 capex passed operating cash flow for the first time: $32.8B in, $33.9B out, leaving −$1.2B (Meta's own figure, which also deducts finance leases, was −$2.1B). There were no buybacks.
read.zh: 过去五年 Meta 几乎每季产生 50–160 亿美元自由现金流，足以支撑大规模回购。2026 年第三季资本开支首次超过经营现金流：流入 328 亿、流出 339 亿，剩余 −12 亿（按 Meta 自身口径另扣融资租赁后为 −21 亿）。当季未回购。

read.en: The $135–145B guide for 2026 implies about $49–59B of capex in Q4 alone, so I expect free cash flow of roughly −$14B in Q4 and about −$9B a quarter in 2027 if spending stays near that pace (Meta gives its 2027 capex in January). Settlement payments of up to $18.6B add to the drain, and long-term debt is already up $22B this year.
read.zh: 2026 年 1350–1450 亿美元的指引意味着仅第四季资本开支就约 490–590 亿，因此我预计第四季自由现金流约 −140 亿美元；若支出维持此节奏，2027 年每季约 −90 亿（Meta 将于 1 月给出 2027 年资本开支）。最多 186 亿美元的和解支付进一步消耗现金，今年长期债务已增加 220 亿。

p.en: $85.8B of capex in the first nine months of 2026 (including finance leases) and about $49–59B more implied for Q4.
p.zh: 2026 年前九个月资本开支 858 亿美元（含融资租赁），第四季隐含约 490–590 亿。

p.en: $4.13B of operating losses in Q3; $18–19B guided for 2026.
p.zh: 第三季营业亏损 41.3 亿美元；2026 年指引 180–190 亿。

p.en: Up to about $18.6B to the states under the youth-safety agreement ($9.89B charged in Q3), plus a $25B New Mexico ruling under appeal.
p.zh: 青少年安全协议下最多向各州支付约 186 亿美元（第三季计提 98.9 亿），另有上诉中的新墨西哥州 250 亿判决。

p.en: About $33B of operating cash flow a quarter from Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger ads.
p.zh: Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp 和 Messenger 广告每季带来约 330 亿美元经营现金流。

p.en: Long-term debt rose from $58.7B in December 2025 to $80.9B in September 2026.
p.zh: 长期债务从 2025 年 12 月的 587 亿增至 2026 年 9 月的 809 亿美元。

bridgeNote.en: Before settlement payments, any new bonds or Class C share sales, or buybacks.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入和解支付、新发债券、C 类股融资或回购。

extraNote.en: Capex here excludes principal payments on finance leases, which Meta includes in its own free cash flow measure.
extraNote.zh: 此处资本开支不含融资租赁本金支付，Meta 自身的自由现金流口径包含该项。
